state.anchor: A patient four-note phrase rises by step, pauses on the third beat, and settles gently into the tonal center.
state.author: 0xAD049E0Edc298C97552eD60071a35bfc60181FD4
state.counterline: A lower answering phrase moves in contrary motion, enters after the pause, and leaves the final cadence unobstructed.
state.intent: Create a calm call-and-response texture where both voices remain recognizable and share rhythmic space.
